sentences: Scalar 2D depth comparison (`dmask:0x1`) takes the f32 reference, XY coordinates and explicit mip in that order.
Under A16 the reference stays full-width; XY share a VGPR and LOD uses the next low half.
D16 returns the comparison in the low half of the destination.
Confirmed against LLVM AMDGPU's `llvm.amdgcn.image.sample[.a16].dim.ll` lowering and synthetic Vulkan 1.2 modules in `test_explicit_mip_depth_compare`.
